pages.text: Young rice stood in straight rows. Outside the rows, other grass stuck up.
"I will pull grass that is not rice." Dingding rolled up both sleeves.
Grandma sat beside Dingding. "Wide leaves mean weeds."
She pulled wide leaves. "This one, this one."
Dingding saw rice among the pulled plants. It had stood inside a row.
Grandma kept pulling. Gaps opened in the rows.
She blinked. "This year's grass looks like rice."
Dingding looked along the rows, leaving plants inside and pulling only outside.
Pull, pull, pull! Straight rows returned.
Grandma replanted the pulled rice. "You lived inside the rows." Dingding giggled.
